D/ CONSTAN [--?PF] AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Trier mint, RIC volume 8 no. 193, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust rosette diademed draped and possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN [--?PF] AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths. D between Victories. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD…
